correctness.rationale: All 4-subsets of the 25-point affine plane decompose into five complete disjoint AGL(2,5) orbits of sizes 150,6000,1500,3000,2000. Affine row transformation permutes column 4-sets and multiplies by invertible scalars, preserving ranks. For each representative row the source checks all 12,650 column choices; each 4x4/3x3/2x2 minor has exact fifth-root coefficient vector and vanishes exactly when all five integer coefficients coincide. A fresh independent exhaustive program computed all 63,250 representative ranks and reproduced the five per-orbit rank rows and global (3750,600000,25875000,133543750). These cover all 160,022,500 ordered pairs by proven orbit symmetry, not by sampling.
